env.up: v=0 is up (zenith), v=0.5 horizon, v=1 nadir
env.dir_to_uv: camera space d (x right, y up, z towards viewer): u = 0.5 + atan2(d.x, -d.z) / (2*pi), v = 0.5 - asin(d.y) / pi
env.origin: bubble position, 1.2 m in front of the camera, 12 cm above the lens axis; same orientation as the main camera

color: sRGB display-referred (Blender AgX view transform baked in)
